purpose: Document independent city-specific first-party registry discovery and bounded anonymous cadastral-map access investigation.
assessment: Fresh English and Telugu searches found official Andhra Pradesh cadastral sources. APSAC's current public ArcGIS app configuration points to a cached Parcel map layer in Web Mercator. Service metadata and a bounded anonymous export were available, but the service is not a queryable feature layer and yielded no safe native parcel identity or full geometry. Bhunaksha direct access timed out.
registryAssessment: registryFound is true because official state cadastral map infrastructure was actually evidenced. This does not establish Kadapa-specific parcel coverage or a local municipal registry custodian; those remain unresolved.
